# Baret

> Baret is a security and policy layer on Monad that runs before a wallet, dApp or AI agent signs a transaction. It simulates the transaction, runs it through risk checks, applies the user's rules and returns a Safe, Caution or Blocked verdict with the reasons. For agents it adds an on-chain spending-limited vault (PaymentGuard). Baret is on Monad testnet (chain id 10143).

## Pages

- [Home](/): what Baret checks and how the verdict reads
- [Showcase](/showcase): six demo sites, each with an honest and an attack version of the same button
- [Agents](/agents): spending limits and checks for AI agents
- [Docs](/docs): how to integrate the check
- [Install](/install): the browser extension

## Notes

- The six demo sites under /showcase imitate real products on purpose. They are not real services.
